company.shortDescription: Hindsight provides a cookie-less monetization platform for advertisers and publishers.
company.description: Hindsight creates a contextual search advertising platform designed to help publishers and advertisers monetize and engage audiences in a cookie-less web. The company's platform powers content-targeted campaigns and publisher units which dynamically change based on the content it is being served against.
